purpose: Acquisition and audit contract for external training data. CCTSDB2021 official test remains the immutable benchmark.
global_rules: Raw archives, images, labels, derived YOLO labels, and prepared external datasets must never be committed to Git.
No external dataset may be mixed with CCTSDB2021 official test or used to select a result on that test.
Inspect the received release and freeze a manifest before writing a dataset-specific converter or beginning training.
A source split must respect its video, sequence, capture-session, or location grouping when that metadata exists.

tt100k.license: CC BY-NC as stated by the official dataset page; non-commercial research only.
tt100k.access: Direct download from the official Tsinghua server. Retain the original archive and checksum.
required_release_content: Original train, test, and other image directories and identifiers
tt100k.allowed_source_subset: Use only scene images listed by the official train/test/other IDs; exclude the 128 sign templates in marks/. Do not use the CCTSDB official test for selection. TT100K image grouping and the 221-category taxonomy must be inspected before mapping selected categories into CCTSDB super-classes.
tt100k.planned_role: External pretraining or pretraining-plus-CCTSDB fine-tuning candidate, never a replacement for CCTSDB2021 evaluation.

mtsd.access: Download only after accepting the official Mapillary research-use license.
required_release_content: Fully annotated images and their annotations
mtsd.allowed_source_subset: Only fully annotated images may be used for detector training; partially annotated images are excluded to avoid false negatives.
mtsd.planned_role: External pretraining or pretraining-plus-CCTSDB fine-tuning candidate, never a replacement for CCTSDB2021 evaluation.

cure_tsd.access: Request the official download link and accept the provider conditions. Obtain CURE-TSD detection frames and annotations, not only CURE-TSR cropped recognition images.
required_release_content: Detection video frames and bounding-box annotations
Terms of use supplied with the release
cure_tsd.allowed_source_subset: Split by source sequence before selecting frames. Do not random-split correlated video frames. The mapping of its 14 source sign types into the CCTSDB super-classes must be audited before conversion.
cure_tsd.planned_role: Controlled robustness/adaptation source. It is not evidence of real nighttime performance unless a reported subset explicitly supports that claim.
